text: Aster Quay Robotics reported a 17% rise in operating profit to EUR 8.4 million.
Boreal Lantern Foods posted a net loss of EUR 6.2 million after a warehouse closure.
Cobalt Orchard Systems will hold its annual general meeting on 19 November.
Delta Pebble Networks did not increase revenue this quarter despite higher sales volumes.
Ember Vale Packaging earned less than last year as shipping costs increased by 23%.
Fjord Mosaic Energy signed a contract worth €4.7 million & expects deliveries in 2028.
Garnet Tide Analytics kept its full-year guidance unchanged at USD 31 million in sales.
